verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents an account-level setting that blocks routing to providers that may train on your data. It also offers per-request restriction to providers with a given data policy, and a community user confirms many people enable a global ZDR-only toggle. Missing for 10: enforcement relies on each provider's own self-reported training policy with no independent verification, and OpenRouter's own first-party stance on training with user data is not documented in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: On your account settings page, you can set whether you would like to allow routing to providers that may train on your data (according to their own policies).
You can restrict individual requests to only use providers with a certain data policy. This is also available as an account-wide setting in your privacy settings.
many enable a global 'ZDR-only' toggle on OR
